title: 逆打工法地下結構~Top-down underground construction
focus: 追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載~Track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls
summary: 本課以追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載為主線，從永久樓板的早期支撐與預置柱軸力與未支撐長度建立系統邊界，再把牆板接頭與剪力交接、地下水卸載與地層回彈連到施工歷程與永久文件。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。~This course focuses on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls. It begins with Permanent slabs as early braces and Plunge-column force and unbraced length, links Wall-slab joints and shear transfer and Groundwater unloading and ground rebound, and ends with Construction history and permanent records. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.

units.anchor: 永久樓板的早期支撐~Permanent slabs as early braces
units.title: 永久樓板的早期支撐~Permanent slabs as early braces
units.mechanism: 逆打先建立部分永久樓板，讓它們在向下開挖時支撐連續壁。樓板此時承受水平壓力與自身施工荷載，和竣工垂直受彎狀態不同；接頭、開口與混凝土齡期決定可用剛度，不能把全樓完成模型直接套用。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變；若出現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Top-down slabs brace diaphragm walls while excavation proceeds below them. They carry lateral compression and construction loads, unlike only their final vertical bending role. Joints, openings and concrete age define available stiffness, preventing direct use of a fully completed-building model. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~An incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 永久樓板的施工受力必然與竣工受力完全相同~Permanent slabs have identical construction-stage and final-state loading
units.practice: 將對照樓板齡期、接頭狀態及牆體位移與板內應變列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現未完成的板牆連接被當成剛接，牆移超過預估，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare slab age and joints with wall movement and in-plane strain. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an incomplete slab-wall connection is assumed rigid and wall movement exceeds prediction, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 預置柱軸力與未支撐長度~Plunge-column force and unbraced length
units.title: 預置柱軸力與未支撐長度~Plunge-column force and unbraced length
units.mechanism: 預置柱在土體逐步挖除時暴露更長區段，樓板尚未完成處不能提供側向拘束。柱同時支承上方已建結構，軸力可能增加而有效長度也增加；檢查最不利施工階段比只看竣工樓層高度更重要。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐階段確認柱暴露長度、側向連接及累積軸力；若出現誤用竣工短柱長度高估施工屈曲能力，柱出現側彎，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Excavation exposes longer plunge-column lengths, and unfinished slabs provide no lateral restraint. Columns support completed upper work, so axial force and unbraced length can increase together. Identify the critical temporary stage rather than using only final storey heights. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage. If final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to confirm exposed length, lateral connections and accumulated force at each stage to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If final short-column length overstates temporary buckling resistance and the column bows, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心~Column positioning and load eccentricity
units.title: 柱位偏差與荷載偏心~Column positioning and load eccentricity
units.mechanism: 預置柱深埋端的偏位難以在後續修正，柱頂和柱底不共線會讓垂直荷載產生彎矩。平面位置合格也不代表垂直度合格，需沿深度量測；局部接頭可能吸收幾何差，但不可因此忽略偏心力和施工容差。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較柱頂、樓板交點及可取得深部軸線量測；若出現柱底偏位被地表控制點漏掉，上方荷載形成額外彎矩，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Embedded plunge-column offsets are difficult to correct, and misaligned ends convert vertical force into bending. Correct plan position does not prove verticality; survey through depth. Connections may accommodate geometry, but eccentric force and construction tolerance still require explicit assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare column tops, slab intersections and available deep-axis measurements. If a hidden base offset escapes surface control and adds moment under upper loads, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 樓板開口與壓力繞行~Slab openings and force detours
units.title: 樓板開口與壓力繞行~Slab openings and force detours
units.mechanism: 出土孔和機具孔切斷板內壓力路徑，荷載必須經邊梁或剩餘板帶繞行。以總板寬計算軸向剛度會高估支撐，洞角還可能出現應力集中；臨時封板時序也應列入模型，不能假設最終完整板提前存在。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對每階段開口範圍、洞邊鋼筋與板內應變分布；若出現出土孔臨時加大卻未更新模型，剩餘板帶壓裂，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Muck and plant openings interrupt in-plane compression, forcing it through edge beams or remaining strips. Gross slab width overstates restraint and corners concentrate stress. Include temporary closure timing rather than assuming the final continuous slab exists during excavation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check staged opening extents, edge reinforcement and in-plane strain distributions. If an enlarged access hole is omitted from the model and the remaining strip cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 牆板接頭與剪力交接~Wall-slab joints and shear transfer
units.title: 牆板接頭與剪力交接~Wall-slab joints and shear transfer
units.mechanism: 樓板與連續壁接頭需傳遞施工水平作用及永久荷載，預留筋、接合器和界面品質共同控制。回填或粉塵可能污染隱蔽接面，名義鋼筋量不能證明接頭已動員；需在下一階段開挖前確認完整的力線與品質證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察核對接合器、接面清理與接頭位移及裂縫紀錄；若出現接頭局部空洞導致剪力集中，樓板整體強度合格仍滑移，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Wall-slab joints transfer temporary lateral and permanent actions through bars, couplers and interface quality. Soil or dust can contaminate concealed surfaces, so nominal reinforcement does not prove engagement. Confirm the complete load path and quality evidence before relying on the joint in the next stage. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check couplers, surface preparation and joint movement and cracking records. If local joint voids concentrate shear and allow slip despite adequate slab strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

units.anchor: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程~Under-slab excavation and loading history
units.title: 樓板下出土與荷載歷程~Under-slab excavation and loading history
units.mechanism: 樓板下開挖會移除原先土體支承，永久板和預置柱逐漸接手荷載。施工機具、土堆與運輸動線產生的暫時荷載可能比服務荷載更集中；材料帳和進度圖必須轉成荷載歷程，不能只描述挖了多少土。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍；若出現同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Excavation below slabs removes soil support and transfers action to permanent slabs and plunge columns. Equipment, stockpiles and transport create concentrated temporary loads. Convert logistics and progress into a load history rather than describing only excavated volume or completed floor area. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. If stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：stockpilePressure=unitWeight*height=18 kN/m3*2 m=36 kPa。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: stockpilePressure=unitWeight*height=18 kN/m3*2 m=36 kPa. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.
units.verify: 對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。~Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.
units.failure: 同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。~Stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.
units.misconception: 樓板設計承受使用荷載就能承受任何施工堆料~A slab designed for service loads can carry any construction stockpile
units.practice: 將對照土堆高度、機具位置和樓板下方已開挖範圍列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現同一樓板上堆土而下方支承已移除，局部彎曲增加，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Compare stockpile height and plant positions with the excavated footprint beneath slabs. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If stockpiling above an excavated unsupported area increases local slab bending, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 地下水卸載與地層回彈~Groundwater unloading and ground rebound
units.title: 地下水卸載與地層回彈~Groundwater unloading and ground rebound
units.mechanism: 開挖減少總應力，降水又增加有效應力，兩者可能造成方向相反的變形。底部回彈與鄰地沉陷可以同時發生，不能用一個水位或沉陷點代表整個場域；模型需保留不同土層壓縮性和排水時間尺度。 判別這個機制時，應觀察同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓；若出現只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Excavation reduces total stress while dewatering increases effective stress, potentially causing opposite movements. Base rebound and neighbouring settlement can occur together, so one level or displacement cannot represent the site. Retain layer compressibility and drainage time scales in the assessment. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. If monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: effectiveStressIncrease=gammaW*drawdown=9.81 kN/m3*4 m=39.24 kPa. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

units.practice: 將同步分析坑底回彈、鄰地沉陷與分層孔隙水壓列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現只觀察坑內回彈漏掉外部壓密，鄰房逐步差異沉陷，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。~Apply the following check at handover: Analyze base rebound, neighbouring settlement and interval pore pressures together. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If monitoring only internal rebound misses external consolidation and differential building settlement, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 分階段監測與模型校核~Staged monitoring and model checks
units.title: 分階段監測與模型校核~Staged monitoring and model checks
units.mechanism: 逆打結構每增加樓板或移除土體，邊界都會改變，監測資料必須依工序分段解讀。將所有讀值擬合成一條連續曲線會混淆剛度改變與地層變化；應比較每個階段增量和預測區間，而非只檢查最終最大位移。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把每階段牆移增量與板柱應變及實際工序共同對照；若出現中間階段異常被最終回復掩蓋，漏掉已發生的接頭損傷，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Every added slab or removed soil layer changes the boundary, requiring stage-based interpretation. Fitting all readings with one smooth curve confuses stiffness changes with ground behaviour. Compare stage increments with prediction ranges rather than checking only the final maximum movement. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence. If an intermediate anomaly is hidden by later recovery despite existing joint damage, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: stageIncrement=wallMoveAfter-wallMoveBefore=18 mm-11 mm=7 mm. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If an intermediate anomaly is hidden by later recovery despite existing joint damage, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

units.anchor: 基礎接手與永久抗浮~Foundation transfer and permanent uplift
units.title: 基礎接手與永久抗浮~Foundation transfer and permanent uplift
units.mechanism: 底板完成後，預置柱、永久柱、樁和連續壁的荷載分配可能改變，還需承受地下水恢復。施工支承不會自動消失，接頭和剛度決定轉移比例；抗浮評估應避免把同一根樁的承壓和拉拔能力同時當作可任意動員。 判別這個機制時，應觀察檢查底板接頭、樁荷重與恢復水位時的結構反應；若出現永久抗浮未含水位恢復，底板上抬並拉裂牆板接面，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Base completion changes load sharing among plunge columns, permanent columns, piles and walls while groundwater recovers. Temporary support does not disappear automatically; joint and stiffness govern transfer. Uplift assessment must not treat a pile's compression and tension capacities as freely simultaneous resources. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check base joints, pile loads and structural response as groundwater recovers. If omitted groundwater recovery lifts the base and cracks its wall interfaces, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
units.model: 原創教學假設：hydrostaticUplift=9.81 kN/m3*12 m*100 m2=11772 kN。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: hydrostaticUplift=9.81 kN/m3*12 m*100 m2=11772 kN. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

units.anchor: 施工歷程與永久文件~Construction history and permanent records
units.title: 施工歷程與永久文件~Construction history and permanent records
units.mechanism: 逆打交接需要保留曾經發生的荷載與變形，而不只是最後幾何。埋入柱、接頭和臨時開口關閉後不易追查，若缺少版本，未來改造可能破壞仍在工作的傳力路徑；永久管理應知道哪些構件兼具歷史施工角色。 判別這個機制時，應觀察按構件編號連結工序、荷載、接頭檢查與竣工版本；若出現改造人員誤拆看似臨時構件，破壞永久樓板支撐，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。~Handover needs historical loads and movements as well as final geometry. Embedded columns, joints and closed temporary openings become difficult to investigate. Missing revisions can let later alterations interrupt an active load path, so management must understand members with both construction and permanent roles. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Link sequence, loads, joint inspections and as-built revisions by component identifier. If renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

If renovation removes an apparently temporary member and disrupts permanent slab support, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

example: 整合算例所有輸入均為教學假設。首先檢查永久樓板的早期支撐：axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m；再獨立檢查預置柱軸力與未支撐長度：EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions。樓板軸向面積 0.30 m2、模數 30 GPa 固定，跨長由 20 增為 25 m，理想軸向剛度由 450 降為 360 MN/m，降低 20%；開口與接頭另會減弱。 兩個結果不能自動組成完整設計，因為永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 將把每階段牆移增量與板柱應變及實際工序共同對照作為模型以外的驗證證據，並保留原始紀錄與尚待確認的邊界。~All inputs in this integrated example are teaching assumptions. First check Permanent slabs as early braces: axialStiffness=E*A/L=30 GPa*0.30 m2/20 m=450 MN/m. Independently check Plunge-column force and unbraced length: EulerRatio=(oldLength/newLength)^2=(4 m/8 m)^2=0.25 at unchanged EI and end conditions. At area 0.30 m2 and modulus 30 GPa, increasing length from 20 to 25 m lowers ideal axial stiffness from 450 to 360 MN/m, by 20%; openings and joints add further reductions. The two results are not a complete design because permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. Use compare stage wall increments with slab-column strain and actual sequence as evidence independent of the calculation, retaining raw records and unverified boundaries.
history: 本課討論的追蹤逆打樓板、預置柱與連續壁的分階段荷載，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。永久構件會先作臨時支撐，施工有效長度和接頭狀態不可沿用竣工值。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。大開挖公開資料列有明挖、沉管與頂進；帕丁頓專案團隊則說明永久樓板支撐連續壁的逆打選擇理由，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。~The focus on track staged loads in top-down slabs, plunge columns and diaphragm walls reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Permanent members first act as temporary support; construction lengths and joint states differ from final values. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Big Dig public information lists cut-and-cover, immersed and jacked works; the Paddington project team explains choosing top-down construction with permanent slabs bracing diaphragm walls. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
